description: Differences between the official emulator and hidane that docs/parity-exceptions.md accepts, as rules the differential fuzzer applies (tools/fuzz/diff.py, class Exceptions). Each rule names the entry of docs/parity-exceptions.json that accepts what it matches; `fuzz.py check` fails when that entry is gone.

rules.why: The official emulator evaluates conditions in two passes and lists the reasons of both (a first pass where resource.data or a lookup fails, its evaluation error standing for whatever that statement's reason is, or the same reason twice); hidane evaluates once and lists only its own. D018 and D019 (reasons listed as false for allowed ways and writes) follow from the same.

A batch denied on a document or a write no statement matches: the official emulator lists the ones checked before it (as false, or the evaluation errors of its first pass) and nothing for the denied one; hidane answers what the denied one alone answers. Matched on the request: with one document or write, the official emulator answers the same.
Precondition failures print the official emulator's internal Datastore key; hidane prints production Firestore's wording, with the same status.

official.message: ^(entity already exists: EntityRef\[|no entity to update: )

hidane.message: ^(Document already exists|No document to update): projects/

rules.why: The same wording, in the status a batchWrite answers for each write.

official.value: ^(entity already exists: EntityRef\[|no entity to update: )

hidane.value: ^(Document already exists|No document to update): projects/

rules.why: A well-formed transaction ID that was never issued fails with UNKNOWN and no message on the official emulator; hidane answers INVALID_ARGUMENT "Transaction is invalid or expired.".
ProtoJSON reads a double through BigDecimal on the official emulator, so a literal that only rounds to zero (-1e-400) is -0.0 there; hidane reads every -0.0 from ProtoJSON as 0.0.
A write to a document of another database or project is acknowledged by the official emulator and lost; hidane refuses the commit.
An array union whose operand holds an array, or a vector with NaN, is stored by the official emulator; hidane refuses it with the message the value gets in a field.

hidane.message: ^(Nested arrays are not allowed|Vector cannot contain NaN values\.)

rules.why: A string with an unpaired surrogate cannot be held in hidane's UTF-8 strings, so the body does not parse; the official emulator stores it, or refuses the request for another reason. Matched on the request: the same answers for a number given as a string would be a bug.

A timestamp that is not RFC 3339 (month 13, hour 24, a field of another width) is refused by hidane; the official emulator rolls it over and stores it, or answers what the time it read gives (a precondition, a read time). Matched on the request, as above.

A query in a read-write transaction (one it began, or one it names) that failed a later check leaves the transaction's lock on the queried collection on the official emulator, so a later write waits and times out; hidane locked nothing. Matched on such a query earlier in the case: a lock timeout without one would be a lock hidane misses.
The official emulator answers a bare 404 to every form-encoded POST; hidane reads the body as JSON. Matched on the request's method and content type.
The official emulator answers a bare 404 to a request line longer than 4096 bytes; hidane serves it. Matched on the request line's length.

The official emulator refuses a collection group query under a document unless it is an ascending key scan; production's documented API allows it, and hidane runs it (or refuses it for another reason, as production would). Matched on a query whose parent is a document.

official.message: ^collection group queries are only allowed if they're at the root or they're an ascending primary key scan$

rules.why: The official emulator reads a sum or an avg over a collection group under a document, without a filter or an order, as a scan of keys that needs an index; hidane runs it. Matched on an aggregation query of a collection group whose parent is a document.

official.message: ^This query requires an index that has fields \[.*\] after __name__
